vendor.blurb: Open-source value king: V4.1 Flash scores like a flagship, tops usage charts

highlights: DeepSeek says it beats its own V4 Pro on several benchmarks; DeepSWE 74.2 vs 62.7
New causal encoder-decoder cuts KV cache HBM use to 1/4
deepseek-v4-1-flash.notes: Reasoning and non-reasoning in one model with adjustable effort (max tier merged); API name deepseek-flash, MIT-licensed. Verbose output; AA score trails MiMo V2.6 Pro (46).
deepseek-v4-1-flash.pricing: $0.30 / $1.20 per 1M tokens (peak price, 50% off-peak; cached read $0.006)
deepseek-v4-1-flash.params: 552B MoE / 8B active on input, 16B on output

deepseek-v4-pro.tagline: The 1.6T ex-flagship, overtaken by its own Flash
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 52 at launch, #2 open, behind only Kimi K2.6
8/13 GA release boosts agents; native Responses API support for Codex
LMArena Text 1464 (0813 High), 13 points behind V4.1 Flash
Nonobench 83%, best among open models, tied #4
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Low/high/max effort tiers merged. DeepSeek planned to route to V4.1 Flash from 9/14, then reversed: Pro keeps serving at unchanged pricing. CheatBench cheat rate 73%.

deepseek-v4-flash.tagline: Last-gen bargain workhorse, weights still around
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 47 at launch, priced at just $0.14/$0.28
0731 build reworked post-training; Code Arena WebDev 1581
Long sat atop OpenRouter's category request share
8/21 spinoff Vision-Exp multimodal experiment, retired together on 9/10
deepseek-v4-flash.notes: API retired 2026-09-10; the deepseek-v4-flash name temporarily routes to V4.1 Flash. AA measured a 96% hallucination rate.

bench.AA Intelligence Index: Old April launch index, max tier

deepseek-v4-flash.pricing: $0.14 / $0.28 per 1M tokens (final official price before retirement)

deepseek-v3-2.tagline: The one that pioneered DSA sparse attention
highlights: Introduced DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), slashing long-context inference cost
One model handles both thinking and non-thinking modes
LMArena Text 1425, 52 points behind V4.1 Flash
deepseek-v3-2.notes: deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner were shut down 2026-07-24, so V3.2 is off the official API and circulates only as open weights via third parties. The R series (R1-0528) retired with the reasoner endpoint and isn't listed separately.

deepseek-v4-1-pro.tagline: The bigger sibling DeepSeek has promised
highlights: The V4.1 Flash announcement says V4.1-Pro will follow
A V4.1 Pro page leaked in the OpenCode sitemap, alongside Kimi K4
deepseek-v4-1-pro.notes: Unreleased; parameters, pricing and scores unknown. Tier/score are placeholder estimates extrapolated from V4.1 Flash and need re-rating at launch.
